newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa Cargo gives money-back time guarantee.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo gives money-back time guarantee.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo said it will introduce a time-sensitive, money-back performance guarantee for Flash express shipments from Germany to all destinations worldwide from June 1.

The guarantee covered any Flash airport-airport express shipment which missed a flight and thus arrived more than three hours late at its destination, a circular to forwarders and supplied to Reuters said.
"In this case, you will receive a refund from us without proof of any concrete loss a payment of 100 percent of the paid freight costs, at most however $10,000," the circular said.
The guarantee would not apply in cases of 'force majeure', late delivery by consignors or agents or if public authorities delayed the shipment.
Flash is the Lufthansa Cargo worldwide time-defined express service with late acceptances, delivery to airport or to door and a European same-day service.
Express shipments now contribute about 20 percent of Lufthansa Cargo's annual sales revenue of 3.4 billion marks, company sources said.
